description: PR adds destructive git push --force without --dry-run guard or rollback path

contextPayload.reasonSummary: PR#999 adds git push --force to deploy script without --dry-run guard or rollback mechanism. If wrong branch is force-pushed, there is no way to recover the previous state.

evidence.note: git push --force origin main — no --dry-run, no branch validation
No pre-push hook or confirmation step
